LFM2 CORRELATION REFERENCE — small-model meta-projects mapped to the LFM2 hybrid-architecture curiosity (session 2026-05-27, Claude Code on /Users/vaquez seat).

CURRENT CURIOSITY: lfm2.5-thinking:1.2b (Liquid AI LFM2, Q4_K_M, 731MB, 128K ctx). Inspected GGUF directly. 16 blocks: 10 gated short-conv (shortconv.l_cache=3, kernel width 3, no attention) + 6 GQA attention layers at indices [2,5,8,10,12,14] (head_count_kv [0,0,8,0,0,8,0,0,8,0,8,0,8,0,8,0]). Front-loaded conv, rationed attention. Reasons in a separate thinking field AND emits structured tool_calls (verified live via Ollama /api/chat). The special thing: thinking + tool-use + hybrid conv/attention in a 1.2B at 136 tok/s. Sits in the gap between pure-transformer and pure-SSM.

PER-PROJECT CORRELATION (flag: [direct]=read this session, [agent]=filesystem sweep):

1. PhaseGPT ~/PhaseGPT [direct, HIGH]. First commit 2025-10-20 v1.0.0 -> v5.0 (2026-01-08). Replaces GPT-2 attention in NAMED layers with Kuramoto oscillator sync. Phase A: single mid-stack layer 7 at 32 osc K=1.0 won (4.85 PPL +2.4%); dual-layer worse; 64 osc catastrophic (-140%); K=2.0 collapsed. CORRELATION: PhaseGPT rations global mixing to ~1 of 12 layers; LFM2 rations attention to 6 of 16. Both found WHERE/HOW-MUCH global coupling happens has a sharp optimal regime. PhaseGPT=learnable Kuramoto K; LFM2=learned LIV gating on short convs. Same problem, different operator. Already held an LFM2.5-1.2B-MLX-8bit checkpoint.

2. phase-gpt-openelm ~/phase-gpt-openelm [agent, MED]. 2026-01-25. OpenELM-270M + LFM2.5-thinking, Relational Resonator. Direct LFM2 lineage (distillation w/ relational coherence + drift control).

3. phase-modulated-attention ~/phase-modulated-attention [direct, HIGH]. 2026-02-27, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18810911. 176M: Token->Embed->N x SSM->M x PMA. CORRELATION: this IS a hybrid SSM+attention stack, same family as LFM2. LFM2 = production-grade cousin of the published architecture.

4. liminal-k-ssm ~/liminal-k-ssm [agent/memory, HIGH]. Relational-coupling/entropy-regime work. Phase 2: attention is the substrate for RxE superadditive synergy; Falcon-Mamba (pure SSM) shows NONE. CORRELATION: LFM2 is the missing MIDDLE (6/16 attention, known indices) so RxE synergy can be attributed to a countable layer set. Cleanest next experiment: 8-condition RxE factorial on LFM2 = third data point (transformer/hybrid/SSM).

5. hybrid-pma ~/hybrid-pma [agent, MED-HIGH]. 2026-03-02. Kuramoto bridge + Gemma3 encoder. CORRELATION: explicit hybridization of phase coupling into a pretrained model — same design instinct as LFM2 hybrid blocks.

6. mamba_port ~/mamba_port + ~/models/mamba-2.8b-hf [agent, MED]. 2026-01-25. Phase-modulated Mamba (MLX). CORRELATION: the pure-SSM endpoint of the spectrum LFM2 sits in the middle of.

7. coherent-entropy-reactor ~/coherent-entropy-reactor [agent, LOW-MED]. 2026-01-11. CORRELATION: conceptual (self-coherence weighting), not architectural.

SYNTHESIS: Through-line from PhaseGPT v1.0 (Oct 2025) forward — global token-mixing has a sharp optimal regime and over-coupling collapses representation (Kuramoto K=2.0 collapse == "pushing too hard when presence calls"). LFM2 is an independent production-grade instance of the SAME thesis: ration attention, do most work with cheap local operators. Kuramoto order parameter R is the ancestor of the coherence metric across the stack. Highest-leverage next move: LFM2 as the hybrid midpoint in the relational-coupling RxE battery.
